notes: Store data is selected by the EX rs2 forwarding mux and captured in EX_MEM.store_data; there is no MEM to MEM path
Forward newest available result; every writeback source except WB_RAM is already resolved in EX_MEM.alu_result
Forward writeback result when EX/MEM has no match; both comparators require producer rf_we and rd not x0
Load-use dependency stalls ID one cycle then forwards MEM/WB result; the detector also covers the rs2 of a store
RF reads are combinational and the write lands at the end of WB so RF must return the value being written when wR matches

Branches jal and jalr resolve in EX with the existing ALU comparator so branch operands use the ordinary EX forwarding network; a taken transfer discards the two younger instructions and a load producing a branch operand still takes the load-use stall

EX stalls while ALU busy is high; ALU start is decoded from alu_op so EX must latch the result and stop presenting the mul or div op once busy falls or the unit restarts while EX is held by a downstream stall
